A Markov chain moves between a fixed set of states, at each step choosing its next state randomly according to probabilities that depend only on where it currently is — not on how it got there. The apps below let you generate a random chain, watch its state distribution evolve step by step from wherever you start it, and see it settle into the same long-run distribution no matter where it began.
